content: As the scent dwells in the flower and the shadow in the tree, so the Divine resides within you; seek Him there, O traveler.
author: Kabir
explanation: Just as fragrance cannot be separated from the blossom, your deepest awareness cannot be detached from universal spirit. Searching outside yourself is a tragic misunderstanding of reality.
practicalInsight: When feeling spiritually dry, do not look for a new philosophy. Close your eyes and rest in the silent essence of your heart.
reflectionPrompt: Can I feel the fragrant presence of life pulsing within me right now?
